summary: A monthly report of ARPANET traffic for December 1973. It tabulates, for each Host, how many packets it sent, split between traffic that stayed within its own node and traffic sent to other nodes, with daily averages. It is a data memo and defines no protocol.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 612 presents ARPANET host traffic statistics for December 1973. Its tables show each listed host's packet output, divided between inter-node and intra-node traffic.

subtitle: A table of ARPANET host throughput for December 1973.

tldr.problem: Network operators needed a record of how much host traffic crossed between nodes and stayed within a node during the month.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC provides host-by-host packet output totals, dividing traffic into inter-node and intra-node counts, with daily averages and overall totals.
tldr.outcome: The report records 73,851,720 inter-node packets and 16,474,630 intra-node packets for December 1973 and updates RFC 601.

today: RFC 612 updates RFC 601 and provides host traffic statistics for December 1973.

sections.title: A Monthly Traffic Snapshot
sections.content: RFC 612 attaches host traffic statistics for December 1973. The main table is labeled as a host throughput summary of packets output and lists inter-node, intra-node and total traffic for hosts, along with average daily internode traffic and the number of days.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC is a month-long report of packets sent by ARPANET hosts. It separates packets sent between nodes from packets counted within a node.

sections.title: Host Totals and Network Totals
sections.content:
The tables list the traffic for individual hosts and provide totals. They report 73,851,720 inter-node packets and 16,474,630 intra-node packets. The report also includes daily averages and a packets-per-message figure for inter-node traffic.

The document is a statistical report and does not define a protocol or explain how the counts were collected.
sections.plainLanguage: Readers can compare the listed hosts and see the totals for the network. The RFC gives counts, but it does not describe the measurement method.

sections.title: What the Document Provides
sections.content: RFC 612 provides a dated snapshot of host packet output for December 1973. Its purpose is to present the attached statistics rather than to recommend a protocol change.
sections.plainLanguage: This document preserves traffic counts for one month. It is a reference table, not a protocol specification.
